children: US powersports dealership's Q3 revenue fell 13%, missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA for Q3 declined and missed analyst expectations
Company says revenue drop driven by lower sales, consumer spending, and Clear Price rollout
Company expects Q4 adjusted EBITDA to outpace Q3, contrary to typical seasonal trends
RideNow anticipates incremental $10 mln run-rate cost savings as it exits 2027
Company sees structural changes and cost reductions positioning it for operating leverage when industry rebounds

CLEAR PRICE ROLLOUT - Co said the implementation of its Clear Price transparent pricing model, in response to FTC guidance, reduced retail volume as customers adjusted and competitors did not yet comply
LOWER CONSUMER SPENDING - Co attributed decreased unit sales and revenue to a reduction in overall consumer discretionary spending
COST REDUCTIONS - Co said it reduced costs by $4.6 mln on an annualized basis during the quarter as part of ongoing operational transformation
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is no "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the auto vehicles, parts & service retailers peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for RideNow Group Inc is $8.00, about 43.1% above its November 9 closing price of $5.59
The stock recently traded at 62 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 63 three months ago
